scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,be,fe -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w @sango/shared" "npm run start:dev -w @sango/be" "npm run dev -w @sango/fe"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @sango/be && npm run build -w @sango/fe
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @sango/shared && npm run test -w @sango/be && npm run test -w @sango/fe
scripts.test:cov: npm run build:shared && npm run test:cov -w @sango/shared && npm run test:cov -w @sango/be && npm run test:cov -w @sango/fe
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @sango/be && npm run lint -w @sango/fe
